title: Tour Guide DayPlan (planner output, one per trip date)
description: Stops in clock order; legs chain lodging (or the day's start, "day-start") → stop 1 → … → lodging (or "day-end"), with a moving day's bag legs and the dinner legs where the day has them (Phase 11). schemas/index.mjs also checks: arrive ≤ depart, clock order, window.open ≤ arrive and depart ≤ window.close, the leg chain and leg times.

spare_minutes.description: The day's unscheduled time after buffers: waits before the next item plus the time left before the day's end.

leave_by.description: C12: the departure of the day's first leg (from the lodging, the day's start or, after a re-plan from a shared location, "here"); equal to legs[0].depart_at. Absent on a day without legs.

areas.description: C12: the morning lodging's area, then the night lodging's when it differs (a moving day). Absent when the lodging has no area.

start.description: Phase 11: only on a day whose override gives a real start (an arrival). Legs name it "day-start".

end.description: Phase 11: only on a day whose override gives a real end (a departure); the day reaches it before its time. Legs name it "day-end".

bags.description: Phase 11: a moving day's bag step. hotel: a stop at the night's lodging before the first sight (start–end); locker: stored at the start point (start) and collected there on the way out (end); forward / carry: the line only.

sunset.description: Phase 11: sunset at the night's lodging, in the trip's zone (NOAA solar algorithm, no network).

extras.description: Phase 11: evening extras near the last stop or the lodging — season events running that evening, then (on an early finish) saved places open then. Events first; C15: events chosen for this evening (chosen: true) before the others.

ref.description: The season event's id, or the saved place's slug.

km.description: Straight-line distance from the last stop or the lodging, whichever is nearer.

chosen.description: C15: a season event the owner chose for this evening in What's on (season_event.chosen_on); chosen events come first. Absent otherwise.

time_style.description: exact: a booking, a set session or a visit near closing time (show the minute); about: an estimate (round for display).

check_on_day.description: Opening days are irregular or unknown: a line telling the owner to check before going.

last_entry.description: Phase 11: the place's own last entry (facts); the visit starts by it.

minutes_source.description: Phase 11: where the visit length came from — the place's own site or a booking (official), a sourced estimate (research), a default (estimate).

visited.description: C12: kept from before a re-plan from the current time (replanDays with `from`); its times, legs and fields are as they were. Visited stops come first.

crowd_slot.description: Phase 11: a crowd magnet visited within 60 minutes of opening or in the last 90 minutes before its close, because the profile asks to avoid crowds.

estimated.description: Google returned no route for this leg (no TRANSIT route, or the WALK request failed): minutes are a distance estimate (trip.transit_fallback). The day carries one transit_estimated warning.

flags.description: Walked legs (Phase 10): footpath = Google's WALK route warns of paths without sidewalks; trail = the route or an end is a trail or hike; uphill / downhill = one end is a hill and the driving route is much longer than the walk.

taxi_minutes.description: Google's DRIVE minutes for this leg, set when the walk is uphill or on a trail (offer a taxi).

buffer_minutes.description: Slack the schedule adds after this leg before the next item starts.

at.description: "lodging", the stop or start point a meal is near, or (dinner, Phase 11) the restaurant's slug.

booking.description: Phase 11: the dinner place's booking rule or status (trip.bookings, else the place's facts). The planner never makes a booking.

title.description: C18: the window's name ("Free time near Slate Museum", "Before your 18:30 booking"); on every window of at least 30 minutes the planner built (planner-free.mjs).

options.description: C18: saved, Later and shortlisted places near where the window starts, open in it and with room for the walk there and back; nearest first, none twice in a day.

km.description: Straight-line distance from the window's anchor.

walk_min.description: One way, from km × 1.25 at 4.8 km/h.

rain_swaps.description: Indoor places off the plan, near one of this day's outdoor stops, to swap in if it rains (planner-rain.mjs). Suggestions only: a swap becomes a stop through a replan.

instead_of.description: The outdoor stop of this day it is nearest to.

hours.description: Open on this date by Google's hours, or hours unknown.

slug.description: A local key, or "lodging", "day-start" or "day-end" in legs and meals; "here" (C12) in a leg's from (or to) after a re-plan from a shared location.

close_time.description: A closing time HH:MM; 24:00 = midnight; earlier than open = after midnight.
